C1288.title: Epaylinks Payment Fined 48.35 Million Yuan for Payment Settlement, Fintech, and AML Violations
C1288.summary: On June 4, 2026, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China published administrative penalty information showing that Epaylinks Payment Co., Ltd. was warned, publicly criticized, had 10.05 million yuan in illegal gains confiscated, and was fined 38.30 million yuan for violations of payment settlement, fintech, and anti-money laundering regulations. The total penalty and confiscation amount was 48.35 million yuan, and two responsible individuals were separately fined 375,000 yuan and 20,000 yuan.
